y-m-74-05.title: Uma sisebenzisa isici esisodwa esengeziwe, sizodinga izithombe ezingaki ezengeziwe?
y-m-74-05.goal: Qinisekisa ukuthi uma inani lezici likhula, inani lamaseli ahlukanisiwe likhula ngokuphindaphinda ngakho idatha efanayo ayikwazi ukugcwalisa amaseli, bese wenza amadizayini amaningana ahambisana nezimo futhi unikeze izizathu.
y-m-74-05.material:
Iklabhu yakha i-AI ehlunga izithelo ezithombeni. Izithombe zokuqeqesha ezitholakalayo zingu-2,000. Amanani alinganiswe esithombeni (izinto ezikhonjiswa njengezinombolo, njengesisindo, ukukhanya kombala, ubude) abizwa 'ngezici'. Ithimba linquma ngezici ezingu-d, lihlukanise amanani ezici ngasinye abe yizikhawu ezingu-b, bese lenza amaseli ngokuhlanganisa izikhawu eyodwa ngokuhlukile. Inani lamaseli ngu-b aphindaphindwe izikhathi ezingu-d (b^d, 'b to the d-th power'). Isibonelo, uma u-b = 5 no-d = 3, khona-ke 5×5×5 = 125 amaseli.
Isivumelwano: iseli ngalinye kumele libe okungenani nezithombe ezingu-5 ngokwesilinganiso ukuze sethembe isahlulelo saleso seli. Cabanga ukuthi izithombe zisakazeke ngokulinganayo emaselini.

y-m-74-01.title: Uma Ushintsha Amayunithi, Ingabe "Isithelo Esiseduze Kakhulu" Sisafana?
y-m-74-01.topic: Ukuhlukanisa ngomakhelwane oseduze kakhulu: ibanga namayunithi
y-m-74-01.goal: Hlukanisa ngokubala ukuthi uma izinombolo zazo zonke izici zishintshwa ngesilinganiso esifanayo, "umakhelwane oseduze kakhulu" uhlala efana, kodwa uma iyunithi yesici esisodwa kuphela ishintshwa, ungashintsha, bese uchaza lowo mphumela njengendaba yokukhetha amayunithi.
y-m-74-01.material:
I-app yokuhlunga izithelo ihlukanisa isithelo esisha njenge-'apula' noma 'ipheya'. Indlela ithi 'landela umakhelwane oseduze kakhulu'. Phakathi kwezithelo ezaziwa amagama azo, ithola isithelo esiseduze kakhulu ebangeni nesithelo esisha bese inika isithelo esisha igama lalesosithelo.
Ibanga phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili (x1, y1) no-(x2, y2) lilinganiswa njengo-√((x1−x2)²+(y1−y2)²). (√ ifundwa 'root'.)
Izithelo ezaziwa amagama azo (izici ezimbili: isisindo [g], ubumnandi [inombolo ngamayunithi e-Brix; uma inkulu, kumnandi kakhulu])
- Isithelo P: apula, isisindo 154g, ubumnandi 12
- Isithelo R: ipheya, isisindo 165g, ubumnandi 16
Isithelo esisha Q: isisindo 172g, ubumnandi 12
Umcabango: izinombolo zezici ezimbili zifakwa ekubaleni kwebanga njengoba zinjalo.

y-m-74-02.title: Uma izinga lokufunda η likhulu, lizofika ngokushesha?
y-m-74-02.goal: Ngokwenza amanani wena, hlola ukuthi uma usayizi wokulungisa ngakunye (izinga lokufunda) ukhulu kakhulu uweqa inhloso, nokuthi phakathi kobubanzi obuthile liphinde lisondele ngisho nangemva kokweqa, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani.
y-m-74-02.material:
'Ukufunda' kumodeli ye-AI umsebenzi wokuthola inani w lapho ukulahleka (ukuthi iphutha kangakanani) kuba mncane kakhulu. Ukulahleka kulo msebenzi ngu-L(w) = (w−3)², ngakho kuncane kakhulu, 0, uma w = 3.
Ikhompyutha ilungisa w kanje.
w entsha = w yamanje − η × 2(w−3)
(η yizinga lokufunda, ifundwa 'eta'. 2(w−3) isisho, esesivele sanikezwa, sokuthi ukulahleka kushintsha kanjani ku-w yamanje. Ufaka nje amanani bese ubala.)
I-w yokuqala ngu-0, futhi η likhulu kuno-0. UHajun, umngani eklabhini, uthe, "Uma ngibeka η ibe nkulu, ngu-1, ingabe ngeke ifike ngokushesha ngesikhathi esisodwa?"

I-app yesikole igcina 'imenyu yokudla kwasemini ethandwa kakhulu' njengenombolo. Gimbap = 1, ramyeon = 2, tteokbokki = 3, bibimbap = 4. Abafundi abangu-8 baphendule; abangu-6 bakhethe i-gimbap, abangu-2 bakhethe i-bibimbap, futhi akekho umfundi okhethe i-ramyeon noma i-tteokbokki. Isikrini se-app sikhombisa "Inombolo yesilinganiso yemenyu: 1.75".
Omunye ilungu leqembu uthe, "1.75 iphakathi kwe-gimbap (1) ne-ramyeon (2), ngakho abafundi esikoleni sethu bathambekele ekuthandeni i-gimbap noma i-ramyeon."

y-m-74-06.material:
I-app yevidiyo inquma ukuthi yiliphi ividiyo phakathi kwamavidiyo amabili, u-A no-B, elizoboniswa kuqala ngesikolo. Ividiyo ngayinye inezilinganiso ezimbili (zombili ukusuka ku-0 kuya ku-100).
- Ividiyo u-A: ingxenye ebukwe kuze kube sekugcineni (isilinganiso sokuqedwa) 80, isilinganiso sokuthandwa 20
- Ividiyo u-B: isilinganiso sokuqedwa 60, isilinganiso sokuthandwa 50
Isikolo = w1 × isilinganiso sokuqedwa + w2 × isilinganiso sokuthandwa. U-w1 no-w2 yizisindo ezinikezwa izilinganiso ezimbili, zombili okungenani u-0, no-w1 + w2 = 1. Ividiyo enesikolo esiphakeme iza kuqala.
Ozakwabo uJia uthi, "U-B unesilinganiso sokuthandwa esikhulu kakhulu, ngakho ngokuqinisekile u-B uza kuqala," futhi uDoyun uthi, "U-A unengxenye ebukwe kuze kube sekugcineni enkulu, ngakho u-A uza kuqala."
